title: Focused launcher completion lacks the per-stage 'focused: passed' line TermAl needs to credit focused cargo runs
outcome: Focused launcher completion lacks the per-stage 'focused: passed' line TermAl needs to credit focused cargo runs
acceptance: A foreground focused launcher run's completion summary prints, within its first 32 lines after the PASS/FAIL line, one fixed-grammar stage line '<stage>: <state> exit=<code>' per stage (e.g. 'focused: passed exit=0'), built from metadata only (no text copied from logs or results), while keeping the 'PASS <runId> exit=0' first line and the 'results: <absolute path>' line unchanged; launcher tests assert the line for passed, failed and full runs
One real foreground focused 'cargo test' launcher run in TermAl is recorded with a passed host Test verification (not refused or absent), and a holder note quotes its record id

completion.summary: Restored metadata-only per-stage launcher completion lines after the unchanged verdict and results lines. Passed full validation and both independent reviews; acceptance evaluated 2/2 pass. Landed, pushed and installed the clean committed build.
